result.title: Method for modifying hydrogel lubricating coating (amended)

canonical_claim.raw_claim_text: 1. A method for modifying a hydrogel lubricating coating on a surface of general equipment, comprising the following steps: depositing an adhesive solution of a catechol group-containing polymer on a surface of a substrate, to obtain a polyphenol coating-deposited substrate; wherein the substrate is general equipment; and compounding the polyphenol coating-deposited substrate with a hydrogel monomer solution, and conducting in-situ polymerization to obtain a hydrogel lubricating coating-modified substrate; wherein the hydrogel monomer solution comprises persulfates and transition metal ions. || 2. The method according to claim 1, wherein a material of the general equipment comprises a natural material and an artificial material; and the artificial material is selected from the group consisting of an inorganic metal material, an inorganic non-metallic material, and an organic polymer. || 3. The method according to claim 1, wherein in the adhesive solution, the catechol group-containing polymer is a poly(dopamine methacrylamide-methoxyethyl acrylate) copolymer; and a preparation method of the poly(dopamine methacrylamide-methoxyethyl acrylate) copolymer comprises the following steps: mixing dopamine methacrylamide, methoxyethyl acrylate, and azobisisobutyronitrile with an organic solvent, and conducting free radical polymerization to obtain the poly(dopamine methacrylamide-methoxyethyl acrylate) copolymer; wherein the dopamine methacrylamide and the methoxyethyl acrylate have a mass ratio of (0.5-2.0):(1.0-15); and the free radical polymerization is conducted at 50° C. to 80° C. for 6 h to 18 h. || 4. The method according to claim 1, wherein the adhesive solution of the catechol group-containing polymer has a solvent being one or more selected from the group consisting of methanol, ethanol, isopropanol, dichloromethane, dichloroethane, trichloroethane, N,N-dimethylformamide, dimethyl sulfoxide, N-methylpyrrolidone, tetrahydrofuran, ethyl acetate, and butyl acetate, an
limitations: L1: A method for modifying a hydrogel lubricating coating on a surface of general equipment, comprising the following steps: depositing an adhesive solution of a catechol group-containing polymer on a surface of a substrate, to obtain a polyphenol coating-deposited substrate; wherein the substrate is general equipment; and compounding the polyphenol coating-deposited substrate with a hydrogel monomer solution, and conducting in-situ polymerization to obtain a hydrogel lubricating coating-modified substrate; wherein the hydrogel monomer solution comprises persulfates and transition metal ions.

L2: The method according to claim 1, wherein a material of the general equipment comprises a natural material and an artificial material; and the artificial material is selected from the group consisting of an inorganic metal material, an inorganic non-metallic material, and an organic polymer.

L3: The method according to claim 1, wherein in the adhesive solution, the catechol group-containing polymer is a poly(dopamine methacrylamide-methoxyethyl acrylate) copolymer; and a preparation method of the poly(dopamine methacrylamide-methoxyethyl acrylate) copolymer comprises the following steps: mixing dopamine methacrylamide, methoxyethyl acrylate, and azobisisobutyronitrile with an organic solvent, and conducting free radical polymerization to obtain the poly(dopamine methacrylamide-methoxyethyl acrylate) copolymer; wherein the dopamine methacrylamide and the methoxyethyl acrylate have a mass ratio of (0.5-2.0):(1.0-15); and the free radical polymerization is conducted at 50° C. to 80° C. for 6 h to 18 h.

L4: The method according to claim 1, wherein the adhesive solution of the catechol group-containing polymer has a solvent being one or more selected from the group consisting of methanol, ethanol, isopropanol, dichloromethane, dichloroethane, trichloroethane, N,N-dimethylformamide, dimethyl sulfoxide, N-methylpyrrolidone, tetrahydrofuran, ethyl acetate, and butyl acetate, and has a mass concentration of 1% to 50%.

L5: The method according to claim 3, wherein the adhesive solution of the catechol group-containing polymer has a solvent being one or more selected from the group consisting of methanol, ethanol, isopropanol, dichloromethane, dichloroethane, trichloroethane, N,N-dimethylformamide, dimethyl sulfoxide, N-methylpyrrolidone, tetrahydrofuran, ethyl acetate, and butyl acetate, and has a mass concentration of 1% to 50%.

retrieved_evidence.claim_text_excerpt: 1. A method for modifying a hydrogel lubricating coating on a surface of general equipment, comprising the following steps: depositing an adhesive solution of a catechol group-containing polymer on a surface of a substrate, to obtain a polyphenol coating-deposited substrate; wherein the substrate is general equipment; and compounding the polyphenol coating-deposited substrate with a hydrogel monomer solution, and conducting in-situ polymerization to obtain a hydrogel lubricating coating-modified substrate; wherein the hydrogel monomer solution comprises persulfates and transition metal ions.

obviousness_result.closest_prior_art_rationale: Selected as closest because it discloses the most limitations (0/5) and is in a similar technical field (hydrogel coating).
obviousness_result.objective_technical_problem: Improving the durability and stability of hydrogel coatings in various applications, such as medical devices, while maintaining their biocompatibility and ability to retain moisture.
distinguishing_features: Use of catechol group-containing polymer for adhesion
In-situ polymerization of hydrogel monomer solution
Specific preparation method of poly(dopamine methacrylamide-methoxyethyl acrylate) copolymer
Range of solvents and mass concentrations for adhesive solution
obviousness_result.technical_effect: A method for modifying hydrogel lubricating coatings with enhanced durability and stability, while maintaining biocompatibility and moisture retention.
obviousness_result.motivation: The claimed invention addresses the pre-disclosure objective technical problem by providing a method for modifying hydrogel coatings with improved mechanical properties and resistance to degradation.
obviousness_result.why_explanation: The claimed invention involves a specific combination of steps and materials that may not have been obvious to a person skilled in the art. The use of catechol group-containing polymer and in-situ polymerization of hydrogel monomer solution is a novel approach to modifying hydrogel coatings. However, the specific preparation method of poly(dopamine methacrylamide-methoxyethyl acrylate) copolymer and the range of solvents and mass concentrations for adhesive solution may not have been considered by a person skilled in the art as a means to achieve the desired technical effect.
obviousness_result.anti_hindsight_notes: The claimed invention requires a moderate level of anti-hindsight to recognize that the combination of steps and materials is not obvious. A person skilled in the art may have considered some of the individual components, but not the specific combination and preparation method described in the claimed invention.

final_adjudication.adjudicator_rationale: Survived 102 + 103 but only 1 GOLD patents reviewed or anti-hindsight level MEDIUM.
